key_findings: Intrathecal melatonin and the MT2 agonist 8MP raised the colorectal distension threshold and reduced DRG neuron excitability in neonatal colonic inflammation rats.
Melatonin/8MP reversed NCI-induced Nav1.8 upregulation and reduced TTX-R current; MT2 protein was reduced after NCI and co-expressed with Nav1.8.
